title: Blue Ocean International Bank Pleads Guilty to Conspiracy to Violate the Bank Secrecy Act
teaser: Blue Ocean International Bank, LLC, an international financial institution formerly headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico, pleaded guilty yesterday to conspiring to willfully violate the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) by failing to report suspicious financial transactions to federal authorities. </
body:
MIAMI – Blue Ocean International Bank, LLC, an international financial institution formerly headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico, pleaded guilty yesterday to conspiring to willfully violate the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) by failing to report suspicious financial transactions to federal authorities.

title: Pharmacy Owner Sentenced to 82 Months in Prison for  $5.6 Million Health Care Fraud Scheme and Illegal Distribution of Oxycodone
body:
DETROIT – A Michigan pharmacy owner was sentenced yesterday to 82 months in prison with three years’ supervised release for a $5.6 million health care fraud scheme and for illegally distributing oxycodone. The defendant has been detained since October 7, 2026, after his arrest for violating his bond conditions.

title: Three Government Contractors Pay More Than $1 Million Following Improper Use Of PPP Loans
body:
KNOXVILLE, Tenn. –Three companies that had federal contracts directly or indirectly through the U.S. Department of Energy agreed to settle allegations that the companies deceptively obtained forgiveness of their loans through the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) in violation of the False Claims Act (FCA).  Firewater Associates, LLC, Lancaster Services, Incorporated, and Manhattan Legacy Services, LLC separately agreed to settlements with the U.S. Department of Justice in the amounts of $405,186.00, $475,000.00, and $125,000.00 respectively.

title: Adelphi Technology, LLC and Researchers Pay $312,978 to Settle Claims That Federal Grant Research Was Conducted in Russia
body:

title: Former Robinhood Employee Pleads Guilty To Fraud
teaser: United States Attorney for the Southern District of New York, Jamie McDonald, announced today that HUAISONG XIANG, a former software engineer at Robinhood Markets (“Robinhood”), pled guilty to wire fraud in connection with a scheme to misappropriate confidential business information from Rob
body:
United States Attorney for the Southern District of New York, Jamie McDonald, announced today that HUAISONG XIANG, a former software engineer at Robinhood Markets (“Robinhood”), pled guilty to wire fraud in connection with a scheme to misappropriate confidential business information from Robinhood, and use that information to trade perpetual futures on Hyperliquid, a decentralized trading platform.  As part of his plea, XIANG agreed to forfeit $125,523 in proceeds from his illegal scheme.  XIANG pled guilty today before U.S. District Judge Colleen McMahon.
